title: Sapphire design review bundle, format sapphire-design-review/1
description: The shape design_review/importer.py accepts. The importer is the authority: it also checks cross-references (an option's track, a screen's option), the append-only rule for parts, sizes, and that every flow pattern compiles. docs/design-review-bundle.md is the authoring guide.

source_url.description: Where the concepts came from. An import with no review named updates the review with the same source_url, if one exists.

kit.description: A house stylesheet every frame gets before the bundle's own. Omit it to ship all CSS in stylesheet.

stylesheet.description: CSS for every frame, after the kit. url(), @import, expression() and javascript: are removed on import.

votable.description: False for a track of shared screens (an entry, a chooser) that nobody ranks.

groups.description: Stages of the journey, in order. The rail and the story order follow them.

code.description: Unique across the whole bundle, e.g. L3.

screen.description: The same code means the same screen across every option of a track, e.g. S04.

html.description: The screen's body markup, at most 400 KB. Mark notable parts with data-c="Part name".

parts.description: Element numbers per track:screen. A part's number never changes once imported; new parts take new numbers.

ballots.description: Optional history: rankings, verdicts and notes cast before the review was in ERPNext. Imported apart from live ones.

source_url.description: Where these ballots were cast. Required: without it nothing is imported, and re-importing the same source_url replaces the earlier copy.

target.description: S04 (this track), learner:S01 (another track, same option position), next, up, end, +1, -1, or done:<message shown without moving>.

next.description: {track: {screen: target}} for NEXT and the target 'next'. Default: the next screen in order.

backto.description: {track: {screen: target}} for the target 'up'. Default: browser Back.

chain.description: {"track:screen": target} where the target 'end' continues instead of ending.

nav.description: {track: {part name: rule}}. A rule is a target, {screen or *: target}, or [[pattern on the part's text, target], ...].

text.description: {track: [[pattern on a link's or button's upper-cased text, target, [screens]?, [options]?], ...]}

icon.description: [[pattern on an icon button's aria-label, target, track?], ...]

aria.description: [[pattern on any element's aria-label, target, track?], ...]

disabled.description: {track: {part name: target}} for an .is-disabled control inside that part.

dom.description: Selector overrides: icon, step, step_label, noinherit, inert, bars.

say.description: Narration shown under the caption: {"track:screen": text} on arrival, or {"track:from>track:to": text} for one move. Up to 300 characters.
